<style id="ro-suite-nav-alignment">
    /* Navigation-only alignment: the existing 28px/16px body gutters stay intact. */

      display: block;
      --ro-suite-content-max-width: 980px;
      --ro-suite-inline-padding: 0px;
    }
    ro-suite-nav > nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      max-width: var(--ro-suite-content-max-width);
      min-height: 52px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd7c7;
      background: #f1f5ed;
      color: #233b2c;
      color-scheme: light;
    }
    ro-suite-nav > nav > a {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      min-width: 44px;
      padding: 8px 0;
    }
    ro-suite-nav > nav > a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid #315d45;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

</head>
